change: Moves the open state of the task menu into the parent and has the popover read it. The part the diff does not spell out: the popover no longer closes itself on blur; the parent's outside-click handler now does.

safety_fact.statement: Every consumer of TaskMenu passes an onClose handler, so moving close ownership to the parent leaves no menu that can never close.

risks.how: A keyboard user who tabs out no longer closes the menu, because blur no longer closes it.
risks.check: Tab out of the open menu and read whether aria-expanded is still true.

cleared.why: The diff touches no request or response shape.

before_merge: Run runs/PROJ-123/collateral/consumers.mjs in CI so a new consumer without onClose fails.
summary: Safe at rung 4: every consumer passes onClose. One medium, low-cost keyboard risk to check.
